name: Cranberry-Orange Butter Board with Persimmon, Candied Pecans, Honey & Thyme

instructions.primary_message: Small dice butter. Transfer to the bowl of a food processor and set aside to soften, about 30 minutes.
Once the butter has softened, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Note: if Fuyu persimmon is unavailable, please substitute with a different crunchy fall fruit such as Asian pear or an apple.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 orange
1 Fuyu persimmon
¼ small pkg fresh thyme

instructions.primary_message: Zest orange into the food processor bowl (reserve orange for another use). Add cranberries and process, scraping down sides of the bowl as needed, until the butter is light pink in color and flecked with small pieces of cranberry.
Scoop the cranberry-orange butter out onto a serving dish. Using a butter knife, spread the butter out in an even layer, leaving a ½ to 1-inch border around the edge of the dish.
Peel, trim, and small dice persimmon; sprinkle over the butter in a single layer.
Coarsely chop pecans, then sprinkle over the butter along with additional cranberries.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup candied pecans
⅓ cup dried cranberries

instructions.primary_message: Slide thyme leaves off the stems; discard the stems. Sprinkle leaves over the butter board, then drizzle with honey. Set aside.
Cut bread into 1/2-inch thick slices, then cut each slice into 3-4 pieces.
Serve butter board with bread slices for dipping and scooping. Enjoy!
